THESE APPEALS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY

THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
The appeal against respondent No.2-Owner was dismissed by order dated 27.07.2021 itself.

All along, time was sought for filing an application for recalling the order dated 27.07.2021 and inspite of lapse of more than two years, no application is filed for recalling the dismissal order as against respondent No.2.
Admittedly, respondent No.2 is the owner of the offending vehicle.
If the liability cannot be fastened on respondent No.2, the question of fastening the liability on the insurer does not arise at all.
Hence, no grounds for admitting the matter.
In view of the same, appeals stand dismissed.

Sd/-
